claim: “The university is now analysing the mission’s early X-ray images.”
note: We are on the operations team, working closely with the SXI team to maximise science return from the detectors.

suggestion.from: The university is now analysing the mission's early X-ray images of how the solar wind interacts with Earth's magnetosphere.
suggestion.to: The team is now using modelling and experiments to get the best performance from the detectors in flight.
